title: Drew Schiller (Validic founder) — 'This book just vaulted to the top of my founder recommendations list'
summary: Drew Schiller — founder of digital-health platform Validic — publishes a substantive LinkedIn recommendation putting Incorruptible alongside The Lean Startup, Organizational Physics, and Radical Candor as the books he wore out building his company. Central takeaway: governance is what quietly decides everything else.
blockquote: This book just vaulted to the top of my "founder recommendations" list. Incorruptible by Eric Ries asks a question most founders bury: Do you have to sacrifice the mission to maximize shareholder value?
